cells.gaps: No adopting act or date is named for the strategy (approval is the finance minister's statement of 19 February 2025 and a World Bank document); the only plan row says its action plan was still to be developed in 2024-2025, and no later one is held. No body, finance or results row is held for the strategy itself. The National Digital Policy 2024-2035 (LSO-004 to LSO-007, LSO-010) is a second adopted national instrument, with a mandated body, actions and no cost, also stage 3; the strategy is the newer adoption and the one the study names.
cells.note: National Digital Transformation Strategy: Agenda 2030: approved per the 2025 budget speech, text on gov.ls, period to 2030. No plan or results against its targets is held, so it stops at 3.
